title: GovCareer Compass Internationalization Catalog
description: Schema for GovCareer Compass localization catalogs such as en.json and bn.json. The catalog stores user-facing translated strings separately from application data, eligibility rules, recommendation logic, and other domain entities.

catalogMetadata.description: Metadata describing the localization catalog. Metadata is not user-facing translation content.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag identifying the catalog locale.

name.description: Human-readable language name in the catalog's own language or the project's canonical language.

nativeName.description: Native-language display name of the locale.

direction.description: Text direction used by the locale.

version.description: Optional catalog version. This is useful when localized catalogs evolve independently.

fallbackLocale.description: Optional fallback locale used when a translation is missing.

sourceLocale.description: Optional canonical/source locale from which this catalog is translated.

lastUpdated.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp identifying the latest catalog update.

translator.description: Optional attribution for the person/team responsible for the translation catalog.

translationNode.description: A translated value or a nested group of translated values.

translationGroup.description: Nested translation namespace containing additional translation nodes.
